_comment: Early vote tracker settings. Party registration is not party vote: these are participation signals only. The routine reads this before its research step. Registration baselines carry their source and as-of date; refresh a baseline only from an official state election office (or a named voter-file vendor when the state publishes none), and update its as_of and source_url when you do.

NC.name: NC State Board of Elections daily absentee and early voting statistics (PDF)
NC.note: Published daily. Contains registration by party, ballots cast by party, and the same-point 2022 total. Fetched by scripts/early_vote.py; no research needed.

NC_raw.name: NC State Board of Elections absentee data file (accepted ballots by voter party)
NC_raw.note: Refreshed early each morning, about a day ahead of the PDF. Used for ballot counts; the PDF still supplies registration and the 2022 same-point total. Only party aggregates are kept.

UF.name: UF Election Lab early vote tracker
UF.note: Every state's early ballots (mail + in person) by party where the state reports party, with the state's own data source and last-update date. Attribution required; non-commercial use. No same-point prior-cycle figures.

research_states._comment: States the routine researches each morning (bounded). Only states with party registration (or primary-based affiliation, labeled as such) can be compared to registration. Find each state's official early-vote report by search; do not guess URLs.

OH.name: Ohio
OH.affiliation_note: Ohio has no party registration; affiliation is the party of the last primary voted in. Label it that way.

NC.source: NC State Board of Elections daily absentee report
NC.note: Overwritten automatically from each day's NC report.

FL.source: Florida Division of Elections, active voters by party

PA.source: L2 voter file via Independent Voter Project (vendor, not the state)
PA.note: Replace with Pennsylvania Department of State weekly registration figures when the routine can reach them.
